owl:Ontology.dc:title: The SKG-IF Ontology: Service Extension
owl:Ontology.rdfs:comment: SRV-O is an extension of the SKG-IF Ontology (SKG-O) that introduces entities necessary to model Service-type objects used to process data in various use-cases, as well as their relationships with well-established entities in the SKG-IF data model. This extension is developed in the context of the OSTrails project.
owl:Ontology.rdfs:label: SRV-O: Service Extension

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain):
* srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link a Service to an APIProfile instance describing endpoint and API specifications. * srv:APIProfile
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: dcterms:conformsTo (SKG-IF labels: srv_api_profile)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * srv:Service * fabio:Work
In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following classes (range): * foaf:Organization
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Generic queryable index of all organisations associated with a Service. The specific properties srv:hasHostingOrganisation, srv:hasHostingLegalEntity, and srv:isPartOfResearchInfrastructure are semantically narrower and are intended to be declared rdfs:subPropertyOf dcterms:relation once the ontology is finalised. Until those subproperty axioms are added, data producers must explicitly copy the local_identifier of each organisation referenced in those specific properties into this field, so that generic organisation queries against relevant_organisations remain complete.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: dcterms:relation (SKG-IF labels: relevant_organisations)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * dcat:DataService * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following classes (range): * owl:Thing
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Library of Congress Classification code IRI for the discipline of the Service. Use the 'all' shortcut (→ loc:classification) for discipline-agnostic services.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: dcterms:subject (SKG-IF labels: disciplines)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * fabio:Work * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following classes (range): * bido:BibliometricDataInTime
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: The core SKG-IF ontology restricts this property's domain to fabio:Work (research products). This entry extends effective use to srv:Service, following the same pragmatic usage already present in all 120+ ext-srv example files. NOTE: The full BIDO structure (bido:holdsBibliometricDataInTime → bido:BibliometricDataInTime → bido:withBibliometricData → fabio:SubjectTerm) is overkill for Service topic classification. The bido:BibliometricDataInTime wrapper exists to carry provenance (trust scores from multiple inference systems) and temporal tracking — neither of which applies to services, where topics are asserted directly by the service maintainer. Kept for consistency with the core inter-entity relation pattern between entities and Topic entities (both must resolve via the same local_identifier). TODO: Propose to the core team (skg-if/data-model) that bido:holdsBibliometricDataInTime be broadened to a general cross-entity alias not restricted to fabio:Work — topics are equally applicable to Services, Venues, Data Sources, etc. Consider also whether a simpler cross-entity topics relation (without the BIDO provenance wrapper) would better serve non-bibliometric entities.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: bido:holdsBibliometricDataInTime (SKG-IF labels: topics)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:

owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: bido:withBibliometricData (SKG-IF labels: term)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:

owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: srv:hasHostingLegalEntity (SKG-IF labels: srv_has_hosting_legal_entity)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following classes (range): * skg:research_product (type software) * fabio:Software * schema:SoftwareSourceCode
Plain string values are treated as local_identifier cross-references to skg:research_product (type software) in the SKG-IF graph.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Links a Service to the software it deploys or instantiates; range is fabio:Software, schema:SoftwareSourceCode, or skg:research_product (type software). Use schema:SoftwareSourceCode for source code repositories (e.g. GitHub); fabio:Software for bibliographic software records (e.g. CLARIN/LINDAT handle).
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: srv:isDeploymentOf (SKG-IF labels: srv_deployment_of)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following classes (range): * foaf:Organization (type: research_infrastructure)
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Links a Service to the research infrastructure (foaf:Organization typed research_infrastructure) it is part of.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: srv:isPartOfResearchInfrastructure (SKG-IF labels: srv_has_research_infrastructure)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to link a Service to one or more research products (e.g. software, datasets, workflows, publications) that are conceptually related but not necessarily deployed by the service.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Links a Service to one or more related SKG-IF research products (e.g., software, datasets, workflows). Complements `srv:isDeploymentOf` (software actually deployed).
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: srv:relatedResearchProduct (SKG-IF labels: related_products)

owl:ObjectProperty.dc:description:
In SKG-IF, it is used in the following classes (domain): * srv:Service
In SKG-IF, it is used to indicate the languages (identifiers)the Service can process (range): * skos:Concept
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Values are ISO 639-3 language code IRIs from the ACDH-CH/DARIAH vocabulary (https://vocabs.acdh.oeaw.ac.at/iso6393/). Example: https://vocabs.acdh.oeaw.ac.at/iso6393/deu for German.
owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:label: srv:supportedLanguage (SKG-IF labels: srv_supported_language)

owl:DatatypeProperty.dc:description:

In SKG-IF, it is used to link to entities belonging to the following data types (range): * rdfs:langString

Aliased as srv_descriptions following the core pattern of titles/abstracts. A core-level 'descriptions' alias may be proposed in a future revision of the core ontology.
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: dcterms:description (SKG-IF labels: srv_descriptions)

owl:Class.dc:description:
The properties that can be used with this class are:
* skos:prefLabel -[0..N]-> rdfs:Literal

owl:Class.dc:description: The properties that can be used with this class are: * bido:withBibliometricData -[1]-> fabio:SubjectTerm
owl:Class.rdfs:label: bido:BibliometricDataInTime

owl:Class.dc:description: The properties that can be used with this class are: * datacite:usesIdentifierScheme -[1]-> datacite:IdentifierScheme * literal:hasLiteralValue -[1]-> rdfs:Literal
owl:Class.rdfs:label: datacite:Identifier

owl:Class.rdfs:label: datacite:IdentifierScheme

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: A bibliographic class for software; equivalent to fabio:ComputerProgram. Its inherited properties (from frbr:Endeavour) are about identifying and citing software (DOI, handle, version, date), not describing its technical characteristics.

owl:Class.dc:description: The properties that can be used with this class are: * skos:prefLabel -[0..N]-> rdfs:Literal * skos:inScheme -[0..1]-> skos:ConceptScheme
owl:Class.rdfs:label: fabio:SubjectTerm (SKG-IF labels: Topic)

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: A place or installation built or designed to serve a specific function or provide a specific service, for example an animal breeding centre, a DNA sequencing facility or a confocal imaging laboratory.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: facility

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: No property list: instances are remote SKOS concept IRIs; SHACL cannot validate remote vocabulary membership.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: skos:Concept

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: No property list: instances are remote SKOS concept scheme IRIs; SHACL cannot validate remote vocabulary membership.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: skos:ConceptScheme

owl:Class.dc:description: A concrete API profile or specification that pairs service endpoints with (possibly) several API standards. The properties that can be used with this class are: * dcat:endpointURL -[0..N]-> rdfs:Resource * schema:url -[0..N]-> foaf:Document
owl:Class.rdfs:label: API Profile

owl:Class.dc:description: The properties that can be used with this class are: * schema:provider -[1]-> foaf:Organization * skos:prefLabel -[1..N]-> rdfs:Literal * skos:altLabel -[0..N]-> rdfs:Literal
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: A web portal operated by a research facility through which access to its services is provided; subclass of schema:WebSite, foaf:Organization, and dcat:Catalog.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: Facility Portal

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Organisation responsible for operating and hosting a Service or infrastructure component.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: hosting organisation

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: A portal or catalogue through which a Service is advertised and made accessible; subclass of dcat:Catalog.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: portal

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Organisation that provides facilities, resources and services for research communities to conduct research.
owl:Class.rdfs:label: research infrastructure

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: SKG-IF alias for fabio:ExpressionCollection. In a Service context 'Venue' better expresses the intent: a portal, catalogue, or registry through which a service is advertised and accessible. The core JSON-LD context maps this as "venue": "fabio:ExpressionCollection".
owl:Class.rdfs:label: skg:Venue

owl:Class.rdfs:comment: SKG-IF alias for fabio:Work. In a Service context 'research product' better expresses the intent: any scholarly output (software, dataset, publication, workflow) that a service deploys or relates to. The core JSON-LD context maps this as "product": "fabio:Work".
owl:Class.rdfs:label: skg:research_product
